# Cyoda

> Cyoda is an open-source entity database management system (EDBMS) and workflow runtime.
> Define entity types, enforce lifecycle transitions, and query temporal history.
> Written in Go. Single binary. SQLite-backed local storage by default.
> REST API for entities, search, and workflow operations; gRPC for external compute processors.
> Java and Python client example/template projects available.
> Apache 2.0 License. No sign-up required.

## Documentation

- [Install and First Entity](https://docs.cyoda.net/getting-started/install-and-first-entity/): Install Cyoda, run it locally, import an entity workflow, create an entity, transition it through its lifecycle, and read state back
- [API Reference](https://docs.cyoda.net/reference/api/): Full API documentation
- [Entity Lifecycle](https://docs.cyoda.net/concepts/entities-and-lifecycle/): How entities and state machines work
- [Configuration](https://docs.cyoda.net/reference/configuration/): Local and production configuration
- [Working with Entities](https://docs.cyoda.net/build/working-with-entities/): End-to-end entity patterns

## Project

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Cyoda/cyoda-go): Source code, issues, releases
- [Developer Console](https://cyoda.dev/dev-console): v0.3.0 desktop application for inspecting and correcting generated Cyoda workflow JSON locally, without a running Cyoda environment. Available on macOS and Linux; Windows can be built from source.
- [Enterprise Cyoda](https://cyoda.com): Enterprise Cyoda
